import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod1 = 998244353L;
    static final long mod2 = 1000000007L;
    static final long inf = 2000000007L;
    static final int maxn = 1000004;
    static final int maxm = 204;
    static final int baseNumber = 1000000;

    static long n, totalSum = 0;
    static List<Long>[] val = new ArrayList[7];
    static long[] sumArr = new long[7];
    static long countA = 0, countB = -1;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            val[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static int normalize(long x) {
        long res = ((x % mod1) + mod1) % mod1;
        return (int) res;
    }

    static void buildTree(int depth, int number) {
        val[depth].add((long) normalize(countA - number));
        countA++;
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            buildTree(depth + 1, number * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void traverseTree(int depth, long number) {
        if (number > n) return;
        if (number * baseNumber + 999999 <= n && number * baseNumber * 10 > n) {
            for (int i = 0, factor = 1; i < 7; i++, factor *= 10) {
                long tmpVal = (long) normalize(countB - number * factor + 1);
                int idx = lowerBound(val[i], (int)(mod1 - tmpVal));
                long size = val[i].size();
                long sumVal = sumArr[i];
                long countLess = size - idx;
                totalSum = (totalSum + tmpVal * size + sumVal - mod2 * countLess) % mod2;
            }
            countB += countA;
        } else {
            countB++;
            totalSum = (totalSum + normalize(countB - number)) % mod2;
            for (int i = (depth == 0 ? 0 : 0); i < 10; i++) {
                traverseTree(depth + 1, number * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        buildTree(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            Collections.sort(val[i]);
            for (Long x : val[i]) {
                sumArr[i] += x;
            }
        }
        traverseTree(0, 0);
        System.out.println(totalSum);
    }
}
